title: declension.csv — the 14 kraje and the 99 okresy (Prague's 22 districts among them) in three cases, hand-kept
description: The nominative is the name in kraj.csv / okres.csv (a unit test checks it); the genitive answers „z …“, the locative „v …“. Read by scripts/seed_members.py for the member word lists (M0 S0.1 T5).

code.description: a kraj's code (CZ0nn) or an okres's (CZ0nnx, a Prague district CZ0100-nn)
